name: Rotisserie Chicken Noodle Soup with Vegetables, Cilantro & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in another medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the veggies have softened, add shredded chicken, broth, and pasta to the pot; cover and bring to a boil. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies and pasta are cooked through, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
170 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is done, add cilantro and stir to combine.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
